<thought>We have retrieved polymorphs for five oxides. To stay within limits and avoid overloading, we will retrieve polymorphs for ten additional oxide compositions now. After gathering all files, we will consolidate them into a single JSON dataset.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
  "compositions": [
    "CuO", "Cu2O", "MgO", "CaO", "SrO",
    "BaO", "Na2O", "K2O", "Cr2O3", "MnO2"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_batch_retrieve_oxide_polymorphs_trial_12/oxide_polymorphs"
}
